svg.title: Bangladesh, 2023: advertising cost per qualified respondent in seven whole divisions
svg.desc: Seven divisions each targeted whole, 30 November to 21 December 2023. Ad cost per qualified respondent: Dhaka $1.02, Chittagong $1.35, Khulna $2.10, Sylhet $2.21, Rajshahi $2.28, Rangpur $2.53, Barisal $4.71.
svg.text: BANGLADESH, 2023 · SEVEN DIVISIONS, EACH TARGETED WHOLE
Fill, by cost per qualified respondent
30 Nov – 21 Dec 2023. Each division was targeted whole (a Meta region), so the coloured area is the real
targeting area. Meta lists seven divisions; Mymensingh, split from Dhaka in 2015, is drawn inside Dhaka.
Both ad sets in each division (one with creatives for women, one for men) are pooled.
